description: Stackurity's curated catalogue of vendor builds of Linux packages matched against the upstream product's NVD records. Each product's CPEs were checked against NVD's CVE API (virtualMatchString) on the verified date: CVE counts, editions (sw_edition) and platforms named. Package names and version forms were checked against the vendors' repository indexes. Vendor builds not listed stay coverage gaps, never clean.

products.label: nginx
products.update: Update it from nginx.org's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade nginx (or sudo dnf upgrade nginx).
products.note: NVD names nginx under f5:nginx (41 CVEs) and the older nginx:nginx (2); open_source is NGINX Open Source's sw_edition, plus (NGINX Plus) is not read. Most records list affected versions one by one.

products.label: Node.js
products.update: Update it from NodeSource's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade nodejs (or sudo dnf upgrade nodejs).
products.note: NVD marks LTS releases with sw_edition lts (169 configurations on the verified date), so it is read with the plain product.

products.label: PostgreSQL
products.update: Update it from the PostgreSQL project's repository (PGDG): sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade postgresql-<major> (or sudo dnf upgrade postgresql<major>-server), then restart the cluster.
products.note: Major versions install side by side and are fixed each on its own line. Versions before 10 have two-part majors (9.6); they are past end of life, which their end-of-life finding says. libpq5 from PGDG carries the newest major's version whatever server is installed, so it is not read as the server.

products.label: PHP
products.coverage_note: Ondřej Surý's and Remi's builds of PHP lines past PHP's end of life may carry fixes their maintainers backported, which NVD does not know of; the line's end-of-life finding is the one to act on
products.update: Update it from the repository it came from (Ondřej Surý's packages, or Remi's): sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade php<line>-common (or sudo dnf upgrade php-common), then restart PHP-FPM or the web server.
products.note: Only PHP itself and the extensions built from PHP's own source carry PHP's version; PECL extensions (php8.3-redis, -apcu, -imagick, -xdebug) have versions of their own and are not listed. NVD names 244 configurations for PHP on Windows only; they are not applied.

products.label: MongoDB
products.update: Update it from MongoDB's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade mongodb-org-server (or sudo dnf upgrade mongodb-org-server), then restart mongod.
products.note: MongoDB Enterprise (mongodb-enterprise-server, sw_edition enterprise) is not read.

products.label: Redis
products.update: Update it from Redis's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade redis-server redis-tools, then restart redis-server.

products.label: MariaDB
products.update: Update it from MariaDB's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade mariadb-server (or sudo dnf upgrade MariaDB-server), then restart mariadb.
products.note: MariaDB's DEB versions are 1:<version>+maria~<release>, its RPMs (MariaDB-server) <version>-1.<release>; names are matched without regard to case.

products.label: MySQL
products.update: Update it from MySQL's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade mysql-community-server (or sudo dnf upgrade mysql-community-server), then restart mysqld.
products.note: NVD names MySQL Server as oracle:mysql_server (348 CVEs) and, for older records, oracle:mysql; a CVE named under both is read once. Oracle's ranges end at the last affected version ("8.0.39 and prior").

products.label: Elasticsearch
products.update: Update it from Elastic's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade elasticsearch (or sudo dnf upgrade elasticsearch), one node at a time.
products.note: Elastic's packages are versioned with the release alone (8.15.2).

products.label: HashiCorp Vault
products.update: Update it from HashiCorp's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade vault (or sudo dnf upgrade vault), then restart and unseal each node.
products.note: Vault Enterprise (+ent versions, sw_edition enterprise, 178 configurations) is not read; its versions do not match the version form, so they stay coverage gaps.

products.label: HashiCorp Consul
products.update: Update it from HashiCorp's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade consul (or sudo dnf upgrade consul), one agent at a time.
products.note: Consul Enterprise (+ent versions) is not read.

products.label: HashiCorp Nomad
products.update: Update it from HashiCorp's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade nomad (or sudo dnf upgrade nomad), one agent at a time.
products.note: Nomad Enterprise (+ent versions) is not read.

products.label: Terraform
products.update: Update it from HashiCorp's repository: sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade terraform (or sudo dnf upgrade terraform).
